b.title: Initial b Pronunciation Demo
b.notes: Close both lips, then open quickly with a light unaspirated release. Do not pronounce it like p.

p.title: Initial p Pronunciation Demo
p.notes: Close both lips, then release with clear aspiration.

m.title: Initial m Pronunciation Demo
m.notes: Close both lips and let air flow through the nose. Do not turn the onset into b or p.

f.title: Initial f Pronunciation Demo
f.notes: Touch the upper teeth lightly to the lower lip and release air through the lip-teeth gap.

z.title: Initial z Pronunciation Demo
z.notes: Place the tongue tip behind the upper teeth and release lightly without strong aspiration.

c.title: Initial c Pronunciation Demo
c.notes: Place the tongue tip behind the upper teeth and release with clear aspiration.

s.title: Initial s Pronunciation Demo
s.notes: Keep a narrow gap near the upper teeth so the airflow creates friction.

d.title: Initial d Pronunciation Demo
d.notes: Touch the tongue tip to the upper gum ridge and release shortly without aspiration.

t.title: Initial t Pronunciation Demo
t.notes: Touch the tongue tip to the upper gum ridge and release with strong aspiration.

n.title: Initial n Pronunciation Demo
n.notes: Touch the tongue tip lightly to the upper gum ridge and let air flow through the nose.

l.title: Initial l Pronunciation Demo
l.notes: Touch the tongue tip to the upper gum ridge, then let air pass along the sides of the tongue.

zh.title: Initial zh Pronunciation Demo
zh.notes: Curl the tongue tip slightly back toward the front hard palate and release without too much aspiration.

ch.title: Initial ch Pronunciation Demo
ch.notes: Keep the tongue tip curled back and release with clear aspiration.

sh.title: Initial sh Pronunciation Demo
sh.notes: Curl the tongue tip back and form a narrow gap for friction.

r.title: Initial r Pronunciation Demo
r.notes: Curl the tongue tip slightly back, vibrate the vocal folds, and keep the sound soft. Do not pronounce it like l.

j.title: Initial j Pronunciation Demo
j.notes: Bring the front of the tongue close to the hard palate and release without clear aspiration.

q.title: Initial q Pronunciation Demo
q.notes: Bring the front of the tongue close to the hard palate and release with clear aspiration.

x.title: Initial x Pronunciation Demo
x.notes: Bring the front of the tongue near the hard palate and let the airflow pass through a narrow gap.

g.title: Initial g Pronunciation Demo
g.notes: Raise the tongue root to the soft palate and release shortly without aspiration.

k.title: Initial k Pronunciation Demo
k.notes: Raise the tongue root to the soft palate and release with strong aspiration.

h.title: Initial h Pronunciation Demo
h.notes: Bring the tongue root near the soft palate and release a gentle friction sound from the back of the throat.

a.title: Final a Pronunciation Demo
a.notes: Open the mouth, keep the tongue naturally low, and make the vowel full.

o.title: Final o Pronunciation Demo
o.notes: Round both lips and keep a rounded mouth space.

e.title: Final e Pronunciation Demo
e.notes: Relax the mouth corners, keep the tongue slightly back, and hold a stable mouth space.

i.title: Final i Pronunciation Demo
i.notes: Spread the mouth corners, raise the tongue body, and keep the sound focused.

u.title: Final u Pronunciation Demo
u.notes: Round the lips forward, move the tongue back, and keep the sound compact.

v.title: Final v Pronunciation Demo
v.notes: Keep the tongue position of i while rounding the lips. Avoid turning it into u.

i_z.title: Final i_z Pronunciation Demo
i_z.notes: Used in zi, ci, and si. Keep the tongue tip near the back of the upper teeth; do not pronounce it like regular i.

i_zh.title: Final i_zh Pronunciation Demo
i_zh.notes: Used in zhi, chi, shi, and ri. Keep the retroflex position; do not pronounce it like regular i.

er.title: Final er Pronunciation Demo
er.notes: Curl the tongue tip lightly and keep the retroflex sound natural, not forced.

ai.title: Final ai Pronunciation Demo
ai.notes: Glide from open a toward narrower i with a smooth mouth-shape change.

ia.title: Final ia Pronunciation Demo
ia.notes: Start from the high tongue position of i, then open quickly into a.

ueng.title: Final ueng Pronunciation Demo
ueng.notes: Start with rounded u, then transition into the back nasal eng.

uang.title: Final uang Pronunciation Demo
uang.notes: Start with rounded u, open into ang, and complete the back nasal ending.

iong.title: Final iong Pronunciation Demo
iong.notes: Keep the tongue body high with rounded lips, then finish into the back nasal ong.

ei.title: Final ei Pronunciation Demo
ei.notes: Glide from e to i, narrowing the mouth shape gradually while keeping the sound connected.
